evidence_rules: PCM byte deficit (0 bytes) is not proof of OS permission denial without explicit TCC/CoreAudio denial telemetry.
MLX Whisper worker readiness (load + golden inference) does not prove audio capture flow or byte continuity.
FFmpeg PID alive or dry-run PASS status does not constitute a verified active recording session.
Master WAV header reporting 0x7FFFFFFF frames (~2236 minutes) must be rejected as an unfinalized placeholder, not valid duration.
Speaker attribution hints must not trigger conversational agent responses or unsolicited query routing.
